questions.q: Read «مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ» (80:19) and name each lip letter.
questions.a: م (lips close, ghunnah), ف in نُّطْفَةٍ and فَقَدَّرَهُۥ (top teeth on lower lip), و in the silah of ـهُۥ (rounded lips).
top teeth on the lower lip
options: top teeth on the lower lip

questions.q: Full makharij audit (pupil PDF): label every letter of 80:17 to 20 with its area. Today's rota group recites 80:9 to 16.
questions.a: Every letter labelled with jawf, throat, tongue, lips or nose; e.g. 80:17 ق tongue back, ت tongue tip, ل tongue edge.

questions.q: Extend: which letters have ghunnah in their nature?
Stretch: why is 17 points but 29 letters?
questions.a: Several letters share a point and differ by their sifat (e.g. ط د ت).
A) the khayshum (nose). The pinch test shows it: ghunnah is from the nose.

questions.q: Think again: Pinch your nose and try to say 'min-naas'. What disappears? What does that prove?
questions.a: The hum (ghunnah) disappears: it comes from the nose (khayshum).
